verified.hardware: nvidia_grace_blackwell (Dell Pro Max GB300, GB300 only; RTX PRO 2000 display GPU not used)
verified.smoke: tool call (get_weather) ok; single stream decode p50 87.5 tok/s, TTFT p90 0.34 s
notes: Measured with the kit's agent concurrency bench (coder/solstice method, doc-check reviews), launched as an llm-helper profile with this image and these flags; the recipes launch path itself was not run on the GB300.
Interactive limit (p90 TTFT <= 10 s, p10 decode >= 15 tok/s): 32 reviews, 54.8 concurrent chats, 38.9 concurrent calls.
Autonomous plateau: 32 reviews, 5348.0 turns/hour; users chatting ~39.0.

What set the limits: KV cache pressure on the prefix cache, as for Nemotron and GLM. At 32 reviews (39 concurrent calls) KV max was 40% and the prefix-cache hit 0.91; at 64 reviews (87 calls x ~45k-token prompts, about the whole 4.76 M-token cache) KV ran 85% mean with no preemptions, but vLLM evicted cached prefixes: hit 0.91 -> 0.24, box output 1,106 -> 343 tok/s, GPU at 1,272 W of 1,300 W doing prefill, turns/hour 5,348 -> 2,018. Dense 27B bf16: single-stream decode is only ~88 tok/s (all 55 GB read per token) but holds up under load. 0 errors, 0 timeouts.
